label: K-Breathe
description: Displays live breathing data from the Tymewear VitalPro sensor on your Karoo. Includes VE, breathing rate, tidal volume, mobilization index, VE graph and time-in-zones fields with FIT recording, plus an opt-in Beta that learns your own ventilation baseline and shows how today differs from it.
releaseNotes: Fixes corrupted breathing data after sensor dropouts (the app wrote the last value or 0 for the rest of the ride), a reconnect watchdog that only fired once, and Bluetooth scans being silently rejected. Zone colours now match the value shown. New: Ventilatory State (Beta, off by default) - learns your normal ventilation per power and shows today's deviation, VT1 power and breathing-rate drift. Needs a power meter. Enable in the app under Ventilatory State (Beta); the first two rides calibrate.
